definitions.short: an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine
definitions.full: H805. Ashuwriy אַשּׁוּרִם proper name, of a people, plural an Arab tribe traced back to Abraham & Keturah Gen 25:3 compare Di. אֲשׁוּרִי adjective, of a people ׳הָא as collective noun 2Sam 2:9 , but read perhaps הַגְּשׁוּרִי q. v., compare also We Dr; Köh Klo and others read הָאָֽשֵׁרִי & compare Judg 1:32 . אַשְׁחוּר see שׁחר .
definitions.rootNote: or אַשּׁוּרִי ; from a patrial word of the same form as 804 ;
